other-tiling-areas-adelaide.html/html[1].source: We install and repair tiles in entries, utility spaces and other small wall or floor areas. Tell us how you use the space so we can assess installation, local replacement or joint renewal. Specialist stonework and structural repairs require a separate scope; pool-interior enquiries follow our pool waterproofing service.
other-tiling-areas-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 我们承接入口、功能空间及其他小面积墙地面的贴砖与维修。请说明空间用途，我们会评估安装、局部更换或接缝更新。专业石材和结构维修需单独明确范围；泳池内部需求按泳池防水服务处理。

other-tiling-areas-adelaide.html/html[1].source: Moisture beneath tiles and preparation boundaries

A damp patch beneath loose tiles needs its source assessed before a new finish is agreed. We check the accessible base and explain whether removal or further investigation forms part of the proposed work. The size of a patch alone does not determine preparation. Material supply, cuts into retained finishes and access restrictions are confirmed in the written quote.
other-tiling-areas-adelaide.html/html[1].target: 松砖下潮湿应先查明水源，再确认新饰面。我们检查可接触基层，说明拆除或进一步调查是否属于拟定范围。斑块面积不能单独决定准备工作；材料供应、保留饰面切割及通行限制在报价确认。
